LESSON: GOOD BEHAVIOUR DURING MEALTIMES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.5: Good behaviour during mealtimes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Good behaviour during mealtimes
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

Try this

• Solve all three and show working.

• Show working for one Good behaviour during mealtimes question.
